Re: Orion Semiconductor v. NovaTech Solutions, Inc.
Case No. 4:24-cv-00123 (E.D. Tex.)

Dear Mr. Palmer:

This letter constitutes a formal demand on behalf of our client, Orion Semiconductor ("Orion"), regarding the ongoing infringement of Orion's U.S. Patent No. 10,234,567 (the "'567 Patent") by NovaTech Solutions, Inc. ("NovaTech").

As you are aware, NovaTech's OptiChip product line incorporates technology covered by claims 1, 4, and 7-12 of the '567 Patent. Despite the pending litigation, NovaTech continues to manufacture, sell, and distribute OptiChip products without license from Orion.

Orion hereby demands that NovaTech:

1. Immediately cease and desist from all manufacture, sale, and distribution of OptiChip products;
2. Provide a complete accounting of all OptiChip units sold since the product's introduction in January 2023;
3. Enter into good-faith negotiations for a licensing agreement within fourteen (14) days of this letter.

If NovaTech fails to comply with these demands, Orion will seek all available remedies, including enhanced damages for willful infringement and a preliminary injunction against continued sales.

This letter is not a complete statement of Orion's positions or rights, all of which are expressly reserved.

Very truly yours,

MORRISON & CHASE LLP

/s/ Kenneth Morrison
Kenneth Morrison
Partner

cc: David Reeves, CEO, Orion Semiconductor
